text:
One hit dominated Dylan Cozens's week. He was ejected for a high hit on Anaheim's AJ Greer on Nov. 1 (TSN), Greer went on injured reserve (Sportsnet), and talk of a suspension followed. Cozens was back in the lineup three days later against Buffalo, his old team.

The hockey story is a line change. Graeme Nichols of Coming Down the Pipe has been tracking his production since the move onto Tim Stützle's wing, and the last ten games read well: eight points, a little ahead of what our numbers expected. The concern is five on five, where Ottawa's expected-goal share is almost nine points worse with him on the ice than without. That's a strange look for a player Evolving-Hockey rated among the league's best two-way forwards last season, 98th percentile at taking chances away. We'd lean toward last season being the truer picture. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says his offense comes off the rush, so watch how often that line gets out in transition.
headline: An ejection, and a new wing
